description: Ferry Fleet Capacity Information is a dataset listed in Transport for NSW Open Data Hub (opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport Open Data Hub. Table outlining the official capacity limits for the Sydney Ferries and Manly Fast Ferry fleet. The Sydney Ferries table Includes the different classes and vessels. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Transport Open Data Hub. Its tags are Manly Fast Ferry, Sydney Ferries, capacity limits, ferry, ferry capacity. It offers 2 resource(s) in xlsx, xlxs. The portal shows 2025-05-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tfnsw-open-data-hub.
